desc_en: A statement of modern elegance for cold days. This pom pom beanie combines a structured design with a versatile silhouette. Designed for the contemporary wardrobe. Each piece is made to order in the United States. We offer worldwide shipping for your convenience. A sober silhouette that defines urban luxury with absolute discretion.
